description: This file defines the NoteAdapter class, which is a custom adapter for displaying Note items in a ListView within an Android application. It handles view inflation, data binding, and provides utility methods for formatting note content and dates.

classes.name: NoteAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter to display Note objects in a ListView, managing view creation, recycling, and data binding.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of Note items.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves a Note item at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID for the Note at the specified position.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or recycles a View for displaying a Note, populating it with data.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Generates a short preview of the note content, limited by max characters.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable date string.
